_about: Help orb dictionary for the Music Playground. Keys match data-help="..." on controls. Merged into any site dictionary. Tone: light, friendly, for readers 10-16.

orb.title: The help orb
orb.what: Drag me onto anything in the Playground and I'll tell you what it does, up here and down in the footer.
orb.try: Drop me on the big dial first.

start.title: Wake the sound
start.what: Browsers keep quiet until you tap something. This wakes the Playground's sound.
start.try: Tap it, then tap Hear it on any instrument.

mute.title: Mute everything
mute.what: Silences the Playground and the radio. It remembers your choice next time.
mute.try: Flick it on when someone needs quiet.

dial.title: The genre dial
dial.what: Turn it like an old radio. Between stations you hear static, and each click is a station.
dial.try: Turn it slowly and stop where it feels right.

player.title: The radio player
player.what: Music from YouTube plays here, but only channels Dad has said yes to.
player.try: Turn the dial to see which stations have music yet.

reading.title: Reading music
reading.what: Quiet music for when you've got a book open. It plays in the radio player.
reading.try: Pick a book, tap this, and see how it feels.

follow.title: Follow the radio
follow.what: Your band picks up the station's tempo and key, so it plays along. It goes by labels, not by listening.
follow.try: Turn the dial with your band playing.

tap-tempo.title: Tap tempo
tap-tempo.what: Tap along to a beat and the band speeds up or slows down to match you.
tap-tempo.try: Tap four times to your heartbeat.

line-up.title: Line up
line-up.what: Tap right on a beat you hear and the band starts its bar right there.
line-up.try: Wait for a big beat on the radio, then tap.

nudge.title: Nudge
nudge.what: Shifts your band a whole beat, or a tiny 10 milliseconds, earlier or later.
nudge.try: Use the tiny nudges until it sounds glued together.

latency.title: Latency
latency.what: Bluetooth speakers and headphones can run a little late. This slides your band to make up for it.
latency.try: Slide it until claps on screen and in your ears match.

flavour.title: Sound flavour
flavour.what: Changes the patterns your band plays: Lo-fi, Chiptune, Ambient, Pop or Nature.
flavour.try: Leave the band the same and just change the flavour.

presets.title: Band moods
presets.what: Ready-made bands named after a feeling. Each one swaps in a few instruments.
presets.try: Pick the one that matches your day.

play.title: Play
play.try: Press play, then take instruments in and out.

swing.title: Swing
swing.what: Makes the beat bounce instead of marching. More swing, more bounce.
swing.try: Slide it slowly while the drums play.

humanise.title: Loose
humanise.what: Lets the notes land a little early or late and play a little softer or louder, like real people playing.
humanise.try: Turn it right up, then right down, and listen for the difference.

ensemble.title: Your band
ensemble.what: Up to four instruments on a phone, or six on a bigger screen. Each one has a part to play.
ensemble.try: Give two instruments the same part and see what happens.

slot.title: Band member
slot.what: Choose its part (bass, chords, melody or rhythm), mute it, solo it or change how loud it is in the mix.
slot.try: Solo each one to hear what it's doing on its own.

fx-filter.title: Filter sweep
fx-filter.what: Slowly opens and closes the sound, like a door to a room with music in it.
fx-filter.try: Use it on a pad and close your eyes.

fx-delay.title: Tape-style echo
fx-delay.what: Repeats notes a bit later, fading each time, like an old tape echo.

fx-chorus.title: Chorus
fx-chorus.what: Makes one instrument sound like a few playing together.
fx-chorus.try: Switch it on with the electric piano.

fx-phaser.title: Phaser
fx-phaser.what: A slow, swirly whoosh moving through the sound.
fx-phaser.try: Turn it on and listen to the hats.

fx-crush.title: Bitcrush
fx-crush.what: Makes the sound crunchy and old-video-game-ish.

bend.title: Bend time
bend.what: Slows the band down and drops the pitch for a moment, then lets it spring back.
bend.try: Press it right before the drums come back in.

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.what: A looper, sample pads, stutter and chop, all made from the Playground's own sound.
soon.try: Keep playing with the effects for now.

pump-time.title: Time of day
pump-time.what: Later in the day, Dad's music gets slower, softer and fades more gently.
pump-time.try: Slide it to Deep night and watch the readout.

pump-weather.title: Weather
pump-weather.what: Hot and sunny days speed things up, fog and rain slow them down.

pump-urgency.title: Hurry
pump-urgency.what: When something needs attention, the music quickens and goes quieter.
pump-urgency.try: Slide it to Urgent and see the volume drop.

pump-mood.title: Mood
pump-mood.what: Each mood nudges the pace and picks a kind of music for Dad.
pump-mood.try: Find the mood you're in right now.

ladder-readout.title: The readout
ladder-readout.what: Shows the steps added up (s), the beats per minute, how long the fade is, the volume and the kind of music.
ladder-readout.try: Move one slider at a time and watch which number changes.

crossfade.title: Drift to the next part
crossfade.what: Slowly fades your band into a slightly different part, over the fade time shown in the readout.
crossfade.try: Press it with the band playing and listen to the melody lift.

auto-dj.title: Let it drift
auto-dj.what: Keeps drifting between parts on its own, at the ladder's pace.
auto-dj.try: Switch it on and just listen for a while.

inst-acid.title: Acid bass
inst-acid.what: A squelchy, rubbery bass that bubbles along. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.
inst-acid.try: Turn on the filter sweep with it.

inst-sub.title: Sub bass
inst-sub.what: A deep, round bass you feel more than hear. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.

inst-ep.title: Electric piano
inst-ep.what: Soft, bell-like piano chords. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.

inst-pad.title: Warm pad
inst-pad.what: A slow, cosy cloud of sound that fades in gently. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.
inst-pad.try: Let it hold under everything else.

inst-lead.title: Lead
inst-lead.what: A bright, buzzy synth for melodies. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.

inst-pluck.title: Pluck
inst-pluck.what: Like a string being picked. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.

inst-bells.title: Bells
inst-bells.what: Shiny, ringing metal tones. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.

inst-strings.title: Strings
inst-strings.what: A swell of string-like sound that rises slowly. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.

inst-kit.title: Drum kit (808-style)
inst-kit.what: Kick, snare, clap and hi-hats in one. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.
inst-kit.try: Make it the rhythm, then add swing.

inst-shaker.title: Shaker
inst-shaker.what: A soft shaker that fills the gaps. Tap Hear it to listen, Add to put it in your band.
